statement: State collateral locked by intents.near over the trailing 365 days is under 1% of net NEAR issuance over the same window.
Every refill of intents.near in the trace window comes from intents_refiller.near, and there are at least 3.
falsified_if: Fewer than 3 refills are found, or any refill has a different predecessor, or a receipt cannot be resolved.

statement: Protocol burn measured from intra-epoch total_supply decline is under 2% of net issuance.
